verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the implementation-relevant constraint that the PCB design provide effective heat transfer through the AXP2101 exposed pad.
Target-specific implementation claim that the exposed-pad thermal handling is already implemented in the board design.
The integrated-board proposal does not mention or specifically extend the AXP2101 thermal-assembly requirement, so the scope propagation is unsupported.
First concrete production failure associated with AXP2101 assembly yield: two of three factory-built boards had unstable L3 output and a suspected exposed-pad soldering problem.
The source establishes an implementation-relevant full-production reflow process rule requiring AXP2101 moisture baking to prevent steam damage; no prior value key becomes obsolete.
